answer: Give every identity a short unpredictable liveness test each epoch: a fresh challenge that must be answered inside a narrow window, like a zephyr that passes once and never returns. Standing then grows only as timber grows, one verified job per epoch, and influence is capped at the knoll a single identity can climb alone. A farm running a thousand clones cannot be live in a thousand windows at once, so each extra fake costs a full extra operator, and clones that miss their window decay to zero.
